name: TC-253 @stripe: a customer's Stripe order reaches the owner with the same receipt, items, total and contact, and the owner works it to Picked Up
description: THE through-line. Guest places a real pickup order on Template Wind (`page`); the owner (`ownerPage`) opens it by id — same receipt #, 'Customer paid' equals the checkout total, the item is listed, Customer Info shows the name/phone the customer typed — then finds it in the grid by the customer's surname (exactly one row) and marks it Confirmed → Preparing → Ready → Picked Up. Never searches by the confirmation page's 'Order #' — that is the DAILY order number, not the permanent receipt.

steps.name: Customer completes a real Stripe pickup checkout
Wait for selector getByRole('heading', { name: 'Order Confirmed!' })
Owner opens the order — same money/items/contact
Expect "toHaveText" getByRole('dialog').filter({ has: getByRole('banner').filter({ hasText: /^Receipt #/ }) }).getByText('Customer paid', { exact: true }).locator('xpath=following-sibling::p[1]')
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('dialog').filter({ has: getByRole('banner').filter({ hasText: /^Receipt #/ }) }).locator('tbody tr').filter({ hasText: 'Automation Burger' }).first()
Expect "toHaveText" getByRole('dialog').filter({ has: getByRole('banner').filter({ hasText: /^Receipt #/ }) }).getByText('Payment Status:', { exact: true }).locator('xpath=following-sibling::*[1]')
Click getByRole('dialog').filter({ has: getByRole('banner').filter({ hasText: /^Receipt #/ }) }).getByRole('tab', { name: 'Customer Info', exact: true })
Expect "toHaveAttribute" getByRole('dialog').filter({ has: getByRole('banner').filter({ hasText: /^Receipt #/ }) }).getByRole('tab', { name: 'Customer Info', exact: true })
Expect "toHaveText" getByRole('dialog').filter({ has: getByRole('banner').filter({ hasText: /^Receipt #/ }) }).getByText('Customer Name', { exact: true }).locator('xpath=preceding-sibling::p[1]')
Expect "toContainText" getByRole('dialog').filter({ has: getByRole('banner').filter({ hasText: /^Receipt #/ }) }).getByText('Phone Number', { exact: true }).locator('xpath=preceding-sibling::p[1]')
Expect "toHaveText" getByRole('dialog').filter({ has: getByRole('banner').filter({ hasText: /^Receipt #/ }) }).getByText('Email Address', { exact: true }).locator('xpath=preceding-sibling::p[1]')
Owner finds it in the grid by surname
Owner works the order to Picked Up
